votes.motion: Approve the Meeting Minutes of August 24, 2021 and July 20, 2021 CBIA excerpt
votes.description: Approves the work session and formal meeting minutes of August 24, 2021 and the meeting minute excerpts relating to the Intention to Designate Central Business Improvement Area 2022 from July 20, 2021.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-3 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on three Police Department grant applications (VOCA, Law Enforcement Mental Health and Wellness Act, and State of Utah Asset Forfeiture) and refers them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Resolution: Intention to Designate Central Business Improvement Area 2022
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the resolution of intention to re-establish a special assessment on commercial property in the Central Business Improvement Area 2022 boundary for a three-year period.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Ordinance: Rezone at Nielsen Estates at 833 West Hoyt Place and 834 West 200 North
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/5,000 and R-1/7,000 to SR-3 for two parcels at Nielsen Estates, deferring the adoption decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 49 of 2021 permitting restaurants in the Public Lands Zoning District
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts an ordinance amending Salt Lake City Code Section 21A.33.070 to allow restaurant uses as a permitted use in the Public Lands District.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Ordinance: Amending City Code Pertaining to Fence, Wall, and Hedge Height Requirements
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed zoning amendments to fence, wall, and hedge height regulations and defers the adoption decision to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Resolution: Public Benefits Analysis - Authorizing the Waiver of Lease Fees to Facilitate the Operation of an Airport Military Service Members Lounge
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a resolution that would authorize waiver of lease fees at Salt Lake City International Airport for a USO Military Service Members Lounge, deferring adoption to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's determination to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location
votes.description: Ratifies the Council Chair's determination to hold meetings electronically without an anchor location due to health and safety concerns and the continued closure of the City and County Building to the public.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 30 of 2021, authorizing the pledge of supplemental sales and use tax revenues for debt payments on sales and excise tax revenue bonds
votes.description: Adopts a resolution authorizing the pledge of the 0.5% supplemental sales and use tax revenues (enacted under the Funding Our Future initiative) to the payment of the City's sales and excise tax revenue bonds.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 50 of 2021 to create and organize the Racial Equity in Policing Commission as an ongoing City Board and Commission
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance amending the Salt Lake City Code to formalize the Racial Equity in Policing Commission as a permanent body charged with advising the Mayor and Council on eliminating racial discrimination in policing practices.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 51 of 2021, amending Chapter 15.350 Salt Lake City Code to rename People's Freeway Park to Ballpark Playground
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance renaming People's Freeway Park, located at 1560 South West Temple, to Ballpark Playground, supported by both the Public Utilities and Public Services Departments.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 31 of 2021, authorizing the City to enter into a $7 million Utah State Infrastructure Bank loan for a parking structure between 400-500 West and 600-700 South
votes.description: Adopts a resolution authorizing Salt Lake City to apply for and enter into a $7 million loan from the Utah State Infrastructure Bank to finance a portion of a neighborhood parking structure intended to reduce the overall footprint of parking in the area.

Approves all items on the consent agenda including grant holding account items, setting public hearing dates for multiple rezones and ordinances, and board appointments for Planning Commission, Art Design Board, Arts Council Board, and Historic Landmark Commission.
